baseline_claude/DEB-Q1.raw_head:


baseline_claude/EF2-Q3.raw_head:
```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main."Player_Attributes" WHERE "date" >= '2015-06-01' AND "date" < '2015-07-01'
```

baseline_claude/FIN-Q2.raw_head:
```sql
SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('B', 'D') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(*), 4) AS problem_loan_rate
FROM main."loan"
WHERE date >= '1996-01-01' AND date <= '1996-12-31';
```

governance_informed/CARD-Q1.raw_head:

```sql
FROM rulings
WHERE date >= '2017-02-01' AND date < '2017-03-01';
```
